Kemp]]. It is a tie-in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' online game.{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20110304-1|text=Deceived Novel Trailer}} It was released on [[March 22]], [[2011]]. The paperback version, published on [[May 29]], [[2012]], includes an introduction to [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']], including character portraits and the first chapter of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''.
